editorial: Prepare yourself for a devastating descent into the fragile nature of memory and love. You will find yourself trapped in a haunting cycle where a romantic reunion masks a sinister psychological void. Ryuichi Hiroki masterfully utilizes a suffocating sense of dread that transforms a standard melodrama into a piercing character study. It is a brutal, beautiful ride for those who enjoy their romance served with a side of existential agony.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of tragic Japanese cinema and memory-loss mysteries.
similarMovies: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
